verified_claims.claim: Cu-decarboxylase 基因为 963 bp，编码蛋白 ~35 kDa（含 0.84 kDa His6 标签时表观 ~33.4 kDa）
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF p.2 / p.4 / Fig. 2 caption
verified_claims.evidence: 'A 963 bp gene was cloned from C. uncialis'；'a protein band with a molecular mass of ∼35 kDa in lane 3 and 4. The predicted molecular mass of the Cu-decarboxylase protein was 35 kDa'

verified_claims.claim: AlphaFold3 锌结合位点由 Glu5、His7、His150、Asp274、His210 五个残基构成；ipTM = 0.98, pTM = 0.94
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF p.4 / Section 3.2.3 / Fig. 4A
verified_claims.evidence: 'the zinc binding site is coordinated by five residues: Histidine 7, Histidine 150, Aspartic acid 274, Glutamate 5, and Histidine 210'；'ipTM = 0.98, pTM = 0.94'

verified_claims.claim: 30°C 加酶加锌条件下，苔色酸→苔黑素转化率约 82%，不加锌仅 ~8%；自发转化约 5%（无酶对照）
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF p.7 / Section 3.3.1 / Fig. 6A
verified_claims.evidence: 图柱数据：With Enzyme+Zinc 苔黑素 82.2%、With Enzyme 苔黑素 8.2%、Without Enzyme 苔黑素 5.3%；正文 'achieving approximately 82 % conversion compared to only 8 % without zinc'

verified_claims.claim: 30°C 加酶加锌条件下，2,4-二羟基苯甲酸→间苯二酚转化率 ~6%；其余条件无产物
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF p.7 / Section 3.3.1 / Fig. 6B
verified_claims.evidence: 图柱数据：With Enzyme+Zinc 间苯二酚 5.7%，其余三柱均为 0；正文 'considerably lower yield (~6%)'

verified_claims.claim: 4°C 加酶加锌下苔黑素→苔色酸 ~7%；30°C 加酶加锌间苯二酚→2,4-DHBA ~25%、不加锌 ~12%
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF p.7 / Section 3.3.2 / Fig. 7A/B
verified_claims.evidence: 图柱数据：Fig. 7A With Enzyme+Zinc 苔色酸 6.8%；Fig. 7B With Enzyme+Zinc 产物 23%、With Enzyme 11.7%；正文 '~7 % yield' 与 '~25 % conversion' 与 '~12 % conversion'

verified_claims.claim: 系统发育树显示 Cu-decarboxylase 与 Polaromonas sp. (Q12BV1)、Rhizobium sp. (Q60GU1) γ-间苯二酚酸脱羧酶节点相似度 84%
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF p.5–6 / Section 3.2.4 / Fig. 5
verified_claims.evidence: 'an 84 % node similarity between the C. uncialis Cu-decarboxylase and gamma-resorcylate decarboxylases from Polaromonas sp. (Q12BV1) and Rhizobium sp. (Q60GU1)'

verified_claims.claim: 底物谱：邻氨基苯甲酸、苯胺无脱羧/羧化活性，证实酚羟基对反应至关重要
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF p.7 / Section 3.3.1–3.3.2 / Fig. S5E / Fig. S6E
verified_claims.evidence: 'Anthranilic acid... did not undergo any detectable decarboxylation'；'the carboxylation of aniline to anthranilic acid... under all conditions tested we could observe no conversion to product'

verified_claims.claim: 本研究为首次在 E. coli 中功能表达非密码子优化的地衣来源基因及 PKS 后修饰酶
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF p.1 / Abstract & p.11 / Section 4
